fleet.subtitle: Every run in this workspace, live and recent.

steer.title: Steer the fleet
steer.hint: Every agent in {workspace}, selected by default. Steering the fleet is a grant you hold by role, not a default.
steer.noAgents: No agent in this workspace carries a key yet, so there is nobody to steer.
steer.agentsUnread: The workspace's agents could not be read, so there is nobody to pick.
steer.keyless: {count, plural, one {# agent carries no key, so a steer cannot reach it.} other {# agents carry no key, so a steer cannot reach them.}}
steer.stopped: The list stops after {listed, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}. {count, plural, one {# more is} other {# more are}} not listed, so a steer does not reach {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
steer.boundaryBody: Each agent finishes the turn it is on, then reads this before its next model call. Nothing in flight is cut. A steer reaches runs in flight, so an idle agent does not read it.
steer.interruptHint: Interrupt cuts the call in flight at the proxy on the <mono>gateway</mono> and <mono>contained</mono> tiers. On the <mono>harness</mono> tier a steer lands at the next hook boundary.
steer.recorded: Recorded per run as a <mono>control.steer</mono> frame attributed to you.
steer.note: Oxagen never executes steering as an instruction; it enters as evidence at the steering position with operator authority.
steer.footer: {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {live} in flight · at the boundary
steer.queued: {count, plural, =0 {No run in flight took this steer.} one {Steer queued for # run in flight.} other {Steer queued for # runs in flight.}}
steer.refused: {count, plural, one {# agent refused the steer} other {# agents refused the steer}}: {codes}.

live.title: Live runs
live.basis: of {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} in this workspace
live.basisUnread: the workspace's agents were not read

waiting.title: Waiting on a human
waiting.moreBasis: more are parked than this page read

spend.title: Spend shown
spend.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# run has no cost recorded} other {# runs have no cost recorded}}

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting on a human.
approvals.emptyDetail: A call parks here when policy returns approve. Denials never park: they end the call.
approvals.timesOut: Times out in <clock></clock>, then the call ends
approvals.mandateUnread: Drew on mandate {mandate}. Its remaining authority was not read, so none is shown.
approvals.mandatePeriodBasis: Counted over the mandate's current period. A reservation this call made in an earlier period is not in these figures.
approvals.mandatePerCallOnly: Mandate {mandate} limits these per call only, so there is no period to count them against:

eligibility.none: No auto-approval rule covered this call, so it waited for a person.
eligibility.ok: Rule {rule} would have released this call. A mandate asked for a person anyway.
eligibility.blocked: Rule {rule} did not release this call.
eligibility.floor: At least one of these is a floor no rule can lift.
eligibility.recorded: Recorded when the call was parked. A rule edited since is a different rule.

reasons.tool_not_declared: No enabled declared tool backs this capability, so it carries no classification.
reasons.tainted_input: The arguments derive from untrusted input.
reasons.critical_hazard: The tool version's risk grade is critical.
reasons.irreversible_consequence: The tool version carries a consequence the record marks irreversible.
reasons.measure_above_ceiling: The call is over the rule's ceiling on {measure}.
reasons.measure_unreadable: The rule caps {measure} and the call does not carry it.
reasons.target_not_allowed: The {measure} target matches none of the rule's allow globs.
reasons.target_unreadable: The rule allow-lists a {measure} target the call does not carry.
reasons.no_standing_approval: Nobody approved this digest inside the rule's standing window.
reasons.outside_business_hours: The call arrived outside the rule's business hours.
reasons.consequences_changed: The tool carries a consequence the rule was not written against. Saving the rule again re-runs the accountability gate.

decide.title: Decide on {tool}
decide.body: Approving resumes the call. Denying ends it. Either way Oxagen records the decision, the reason, and who made it.
decide.noteHint: Required to deny, optional to approve. It goes on the record.
decide.settled: This call was already resolved by {by}. Nothing here can change it.
decide.eligibilityUnread: The recorded evaluation could not be read again ({code}). The line above is what the page read.

failure.noteRequired: Write the reason this call is denied.
failure.noPrincipal: Oxagen could not establish who you are. Sign in again. The call is untouched.
failure.orgRoleRequired: Your roles do not cover this decision. On a call a mandate parked, the office accountable for the mandate's consequences answers it. The call is untouched.
failure.noRoleCoversAllTags: No single organization role is named for all of this mandate's consequence tags, so nobody can answer this call until the workspace names one. The call is untouched.
failure.notAnApprover: This mandate's approval rule names who may answer, and you are not one of them. The call is untouched.
failure.agentCannotResolveOwnMandate: An agent cannot answer a call its own mandate parked. A person answers. The call is untouched.
failure.approvalExpired: No pending call matched: it timed out, somebody else answered it, or it was never in this workspace. Nothing was billed.
failure.invalid: The decision was refused before it was sent. The call is untouched.
failure.pendingApproval: Your access request {accessRequestId} is still waiting. The call is untouched.
failure.exhausted: A decision is the one billed action here, and this organization's credit is exhausted ({code}). The call is untouched.
failure.refused: The decision was refused ({code}). The call is untouched.
failure.unavailable: The decision did not reach the kernel ({code}). The call is untouched, so it is safe to try again.

runs.title: Runs
runs.tokensUnsorted: Runs carry no token figure yet, so there is nothing to sort.
runs.exportFailed: The export bundle for {run} was not queued. {reason}

pause.title: Pause this run
pause.body: Takes effect at the next boundary: the model call or tool call now in flight completes, and nothing new is dispatched. The run keeps its token and its budget reservation; pending approvals keep their clocks.
pause.reason: Reason — the model reads this on resume, so write it for the agent
pause.note: Pause is not cancel. Nothing is revoked, and the run resumes exactly where it stopped; the gap is visible in the chain and the receipts.
pause.queued: Pause queued for {run}. It takes effect at the next boundary.

empty.title: No runs yet in {workspace}
empty.body: Nothing has reached Oxagen from this workspace. A run appears the moment a registered agent makes its first model call — you do not create runs here, agents do.

error.title: Fleet could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered <c>{status} {code}</c>. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.

denied.title: You cannot see this workspace
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission} on {ws}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.decidedByValue: policy not recorded · deny wins over every allow

pending.title: Your access request is waiting
pending.body: Reading this workspace parked for approval. The request is {request}.

requestAccess.title: Request access
requestAccess.note: Granting a role is a governed action. It will appear in the audit record with the granter’s name, your name, and this reason.
requestAccess.unbacked: Oxagen records no access request yet, so this cannot be sent. Ask an organization owner to grant {permission} on {ws}; the grant lands in the audit record.

incident.title: Open an incident
incident.subject: Subject

severities.critical: critical — money moved that Oxagen did not govern

incident.unbacked: Oxagen has no record to raise an incident in yet, so this cannot be sent. Report {status} {code} at {at} to whoever runs this deployment.
